gotchas: Sign in at figma.com/login (Email + Password on one page, submit with Enter; no code on 2026-10-07). page.goto on figma.com can exceed 45 s at domcontentloaded although the document committed: wait for the field instead of re-navigating. Lands on /files/team/<id>/recents-and-sharing.

Signed in, the pricing page's 'Select Professional plan' only reloads pricing. The working route is in-app: sidebar card 'See what's included' (Your plan and usage) -> 'Starter hub' dialog -> its 'Upgrade' (bottom-left) -> 'Which plan and seats would you like?' dialog.

In that dialog the Professional Monthly/Annual toggle defaults to Annual; the 'Monthly' label is covered by its radio, so click input[type=radio][value=monthly]. Two buttons read 'Upgrade and choose seats': Professional is first (nth=0), Organization second.

Full page 'Who are you upgrading to a Professional plan?' ('Just me' preselected) -> 'Next: Seats and payment' -> 'Enter your payment details.' (breadcrumb Solo or team > Seats & payment information > Review). 1 Full seat, $20/mo monthly.

Card number, expiry and CVC are one Stripe frame (iframe title 'Secure payment input frame', input[name=number|expiry|cvc]). On the page: Name on payment method, Billing address, Apt (optional), Country select (first <select>, US default), City, State (second <select>, option values are codes like CA), Zip code. A select:has(option:text-is(...)) selector timed out; use 'select >> nth=1' with value CA.
'Next: Review' goes to a Review step that shows the total with taxes; the charge happens there, not on this page.

Verified 2026-10-07 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: billing fields and expiry/number/CVC filled with no field error. Stopped before Next: Review.

2026-10-09: billing details moved into a Stripe Address Element iframe (iframe[title*=address i]: input[name=name], select[name=country], input[name=addressLine1|addressLine2|locality|postalCode]); the page-level Name/Zip/State fields above were not present. Card frame unchanged.

Once any vault token is on the page, the proxy refuses selectors that test [value=...], so input[type=radio][value=monthly] stops working mid-run; use label:has-text("Monthly") or keep Annual (the card fields are the same).
A new account first goes through the onboarding dialog (see the signup recipe); open figma.com/files after it to reach the 'See what's included' card.
